An incomplete Iron Age or Roman cast copper alloy strip bow brooch dating to the 1st century AD. It consists of a section of the bow with the remnants of the pin slot at the top. All else is missing. The front of the bow is decorated with three longitudinal strips of inscribed hatching, one up the centre of the bow, the other two at the extreme edges. It is 29.19mm in length, 8.77mm in width,…
